title: Monitoring for Shifts at Unknown Times: Parameter-Free Conditional Conformal Martingales
abstract: arXiv:2610.17343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conditional conformal test martingales provide sequential tests for detecting distribution shifts, using a fixed reference dataset to avoid contamination from test-time samples. Prior work used a penalized betting function via online optimization with smoothing, clipping, and other hyperparameters, which can adapt slowly when a shift occurs after a long stationary period. In this work, we introduce an approach that requires no hyperparameters and provably adapts quickly to shifts occurring at unknown times. Our key idea is to frame the penalized betting problem as portfolio selection in a three-asset market. Then, we use a restarting universal portfolio, with a heavy-tailed wealth allocation over time. We establish anytime false-alarm control and derive optimal finite-sample bounds on detection delay under detectable alternatives. translated_title: 在未知时间监测分布偏移：无参数条件保形鞅
translated_abstract: 条件保形检验鞅为检测分布偏移提供了序贯检验方法，它使用固定的参考数据集来避免测试时样本的污染。先前的工作通过在线优化使用带有平滑、裁剪等超参数的惩罚下注函数，当偏移在长期平稳期之后发生时，这种方法可能适应缓慢。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种不需要超参数的方法，并且可以证明它能够快速适应在未知时间发生的偏移。我们的核心思想是将惩罚下注问题构建为三资产市场中的投资组合选择问题。然后，我们使用一种重启的通用投资组合，并在时间上进行重尾的财富分配。我们建立了任意时刻的虚警控制，并在可检测的备择假设下推导出了检测延迟的最优有限样本界。我们还开发了一种基于FFT的实现，可以在T轮内计算投资组合序列。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无超参数的条件保形鞅方法，通过将惩罚下注问题转化为三资产市场的投资组合选择问题，并采用带重尾财富分配的重启通用投资组合，实现了对未知时间发生的分布偏移的快速自适应检测，同时保证任意时刻虚警控制和最优的有限样本检测延迟界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a hyperparameter-free conditional conformal test martingale that frames penalized betting as portfolio selection in a three-asset market using a restarting universal portfolio with heavy-tailed wealth allocation, provably adapting quickly to distribution shifts occurring at unknown times while maintaining anytime false-alarm control and optimal finite-sample detection delay bounds.
